standout_feature: AI PNR Confirmation Prediction — probabilistic AI tells waitlisted passengers their confirmation odds in real time
biggest_gap: Web experience is severely limited vs. the mobile app — many features 404 on web
biggest_advantage: Deepest train AI in the benchmark cycle: PNR prediction, coach position, platform locator, food-on-train. No other product comes close for rail travel.
saudia_relevance: High — AI-as-Predictor model is directly applicable to Saudia's flight context: upgrade prediction, seat confirmation, disruption alerts
ai_architecture: AI-as-Predictor — third distinct AI philosophy confirmed
key_ai_features: PNR Confirmation Probability Prediction — analyses waitlist data and historical trends
Live Train Running Status — real-time GPS tracking
Coach Position Predictor — tells you exactly where your coach stops on the platform
Platform Locator — which platform your train departs from
Order Food On Train — meal ordering at your seat mid-journey

classification.note: ixigo is primarily a mobile-first app. The web experience is substantially thinner than what mobile users see. Scores reflect web benchmark only.

executive_recommendation.description: A single proactive push notification delivered 4 hours before every Saudia departure: on-time probability, upgrade status, seat assignment, gate, boarding group, and connection confidence — all in one card.
executive_recommendation.why_it_matters: ixigo's PNR Prediction proves passengers will engage deeply with AI that resolves pre-travel anxiety with a specific number rather than a vague status. Saudia already owns every data point required. No OTA can send this notification because no OTA has access to Saudia's real-time flight operations, upgrade waitlist, and seat inventory simultaneously.
executive_recommendation.business_impact: Differentiates the Saudia app from every OTA on the market. Reduces pre-departure call center volume. Drives app installs and notification opt-ins. Delivers measurable NPS improvement at the highest-anxiety moment of the traveler journey.
